eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Plumas, CA; at 7:22 PM on AUG 13, 2021 Effective until 7:22 PM AUG 14, 2021. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is the Plumas County Sheriffs Office with a Mandatory Evacuation Order for ALL OF GENESSE VALLEY southeast of Taylorsville up Genesee road to just south of Babock Crossing Walker Mine Road and North portion of Beckwourth Genesee Road  If you remain emergency personnel may not be able to help Please evacuate South on Highway 89 Please visit the Plumas County Sheriffs Office Facebook Page or visit Plumas County website for more information
